introduce: Put your left hand underneath your thigh with your palm up. Keep your left shoulder flat. \n\nPut your right hand on the left side of your head, then gently pull your head towards the right. Hold it for a few seconds.
name: SIDE NECK STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please always keep your left shoulder flat.

introduce: Put your right hand underneath your thigh with your palm up. Keep your right shoulder flat. \n\nPut your left hand on the right side of your head, then gently pull your head towards the left. Hold it for a few seconds.
name: SIDE NECK STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please always keep your right shoulder flat.

introduce: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight, extend your left leg in front of you with your heel on the ground, toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.

introduce: Sit on the edge of a chair with your back straight, extend your right leg in front of you with your heel on the ground, toes pointing up.\n\nReach both of your hands towards your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: SEATED HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please keep your knee straight during the stretch.
Please keep the other foot flat on the ground.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair.

Put your left hand on your right knee and your right hand behind you on the chair.

Inhale, lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly twist your upper body to the right. Hold for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST LEFT

tips.text: Please don't let your hips off the chair.
Please don't tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.

introduce:
Sit up nice and tall in the chair.

Put your right hand on your left knee and your left hand behind you on the chair.

Inhale, lengthen your spine, then exhale and slowly twist your upper body to the left. Hold for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR SPINAL TWIST RIGHT

tips.text: Please don't let your hips off the chair.
Please don't tilt to the side.
This exercise can relieve your back pain.

introduce:
Sit on a chair. Put your left ankle on your right knee.

Hinge forward from the hips, using your left hand to push your knee down toward the ground. 

Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce:
Sit on a chair. Put your right ankle on your left knee.

Hinge forward from the hips, using your right hand to push your knee down toward the ground. 

Hold it for a few seconds.
name: CHAIR GLUTE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: To make a deeper stretch, pull your crossed leg closer to your body.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and glutes and can reduce your lower back pain.

introduce: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor and your hands on your thighs.\n\nRock back and forth from your toes to your heels. Repeat the exercise.
name: CHAIR HEEL TO TOE ROCK

tips.text: Keep your feet parallel and your ankles stable.
Please pause at the top for a few seconds.
This exercise is great for improving ankle mobility and balance.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs hip-with apart and your feet flat on the floor.

Take a deep breath and as you exhale, slowly curl your chin to your chest, draw your lower belly in and round your back. 

Fold your body and press your entire palms on the floor. With every exhalation, move your chest and shoulders away from your thighs. Hold this position for a few breaths.
name: CHAIR CHILD'S POSE

tips.text: Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
This pose helps to release tightness in your neck, shoulders, lower back, and hips.

introduce:
Sit on a chair with your legs a little wider than hip-with apart. Let your arms hang naturally at the sides of your body. 

Release your legs and windshield wiper your legs from side to side.
name: CHAIR WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: This exercise warms up your hips and knees.

introduce:
Prepare a chair without armrests where your feet can touch the floor when sitting. 

Sit on the edge of the chair. Inhale, open your left leg out towards the left. Make sure your knee is aligned with your ankle, pointing in the same direction as your toes and forming a 90-degree angle.

Exhale, extend your right leg to the right with your toes facing forward. Raise your arms to your sides at shoulder height with your palms down.

Draw your belly in, tuck your tailbone down, and lift your chest. Take your gaze to your left hand. Hold this position.
name: CHAIR WARRIOR II LEFT

tips.text: Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Draw your shoulders away from your ears and keep them relaxed.
This exercise strengthens your lower body and shoulders.

tips.text: Keep your bent knee in line with your toes.
Don't let your bent knee go over your toes.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
